name: zrndr_span_shade_16_from_pal8_switch_vshift
description: zRndr::SpanShade16FromPal8SwitchVShift shades 8-bit paletted texture samples through the active shade bucket and writes 16-bit palette results into the destination span.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 zrndr_span_shade_16_from_pal8_switch_vshift --auto-chunk passes for 0x49f180 with profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_zrndr_esp_pivot_raw_asm_facs, relocation mask count 420, trim_nops 12, table-inclusive BN size 1172, VC5 size 1184, BN reference cache tools/vc5_verify_bn_cache/zrndr_span_shade_16_from_pal8_switch_vshift, and zRndr.obj/zRndr.cod artifacts under build/vc5-verify.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49f180 validates the texVShift range check, switch dispatch for values 10 through 17, per-case texture U/V mask and shift formulas, 8-bit texel fetch, shade bucket extraction from g_spanActiveShadeFixed16, g_spanActiveShadeStepFixed16 advancement, palette expansion, and reverse destination writes.
The native span-shade smoke verifies paletted shade-bucket output for a four-pixel span, fixed shade advancement, reverse destination order, and the invalid texVShift early return.
